usedFor: Text2reach sends and cancels bulk texts with “Send SMS” and “Cancel Scheduled SMS”, always through your Text2reach account.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Send SMS” in Text2reach
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can start a text back, sent through your Text2reach account.

watchOut: Texts reach people outside the business, so “Send SMS” waits for your approval.
